title: Setting Up Your FastAPI Environment
description: Install FastAPI and Uvicorn, and run your first app.

slides.title: What is FastAPI? 🚀
slides.content:
# FastAPI: The Modern Web Framework

FastAPI is a modern, fast (high-performance) web framework for building APIs with Python 3.7+.

- **Automatic interactive API docs** (Swagger UI and ReDoc).
- **Fast** – on par with Node.js and Go.
- **Type hints** drive request validation and serialization.
- **Async** support built-in.

Let's get it running!

slides.title: Installation
slides.content: Open your terminal and run these commands.
slides.codeSnippet:
pip install fastapi
pip install uvicorn[standard]

quizData.question: Which ASGI server is commonly used to run FastAPI apps?
quizData.explanation: Uvicorn is the recommended ASGI server for FastAPI, providing high performance and async support.
